body.name: Observable rejection certificates
body.construction: For a rejected state \(J\), an ordered conditional-independence certificate chooses a topological order \(\pi_J\), a nonadjacent pair \(u,v\) with \(u\) preceding \(v\), and \(S=\operatorname{Pred}_{\pi_J}(v)\setminus\{u\}\), and evaluates \(f_{uvS}(\Sigma)=\det(\Sigma_{[u,S],[v,S]})\). A blocked-regression certificate chooses \(j\in V\) and distinct \(u,v\) in one block of \(\Pi^J_j\), puts \(P=\operatorname{pa}_{G_J}(j)\), and evaluates \(L_{j;u,v}(\Sigma)=(e_u-e_v)^{\mathsf T}\operatorname{adj}(\Sigma_{P,P})\Sigma_{P,j}\).
